newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks seen up on electronics, Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks seen up on electronics, Wall Street.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were expected to continue their uptrend on Friday triggered by red-hot electronics and recent Wall Street rallies, brokers said.
The stock turnover would be a key to determine whether the weighted index could make more gains, brokers said.
On Thursday, a dramatic rebound by trendsetting electronics sector sent share prices surging sharply, pushing the index 251.36 points or 2.68 percent higher at 9,632.42.
A 9,630-9,750 range was seen for Friday.
"Electronics should remain as the major sector to carry the market, and recent Wall Street rallies should induce a bullish sentiment," said Tsai Ming-yen of Taiwan International Securities.
Wall Street has risen for three straight days.
Brokers said if the stock turnover could end larger compared with Thursday's close, the index should be able to surge further.
Thursday's T$150.9 billion turnover was strong but well below the T$200 billion-plus level seen almost daily in recent weeks. -- Lawrence Chung, Taipei newsroom (886-2-5080815)
